landing.nm.title: Vinko — challenges and {nouns} with friends
landing.nm.h1: Your group is already arguing. Make it official who was right.
landing.nm.sub: Create a {noun} about anything in 30 seconds, share it on WhatsApp and let everyone pick. Whoever's right earns Accuracy and the right to say "told you so".
landing.modes.title: Play your way
landing.modes.vinkos.title: With Vinkos
landing.modes.vinkos.body: Free virtual points to play with anyone, in Discover or the league. Earned by playing and inviting. Never bought nor redeemed for money.
landing.modes.free.title: In your group
landing.modes.free.body: Private {nouns} for your people, with a weekly ranking: who's right most, who's leading and who's at the bottom.
landing.step.create: Create your {noun} in 30 seconds: a question and its options.
landing.step.resolve: When the result is known, the creator marks it and Vinko shows who was right.
landing.final.title: Call it first. Brag after.
landing.final.body: Free, no download, 30 seconds. Whoever's right gets to say so.
landing.demo.d.q: Who falls asleep first during the movie?
landing.demo.c.q: Does Chema pass his driving test first time?
